seo.title: Careers — Indlio
seo.description: Join Indlio. We're hiring people who want to ship booking software SMEs can use on day one.

title: Build tools people actually use.
subtitle: A small team shipping booking software for studios and practices. High trust, clear work, and no six-week implementations — including how we hire.

principles.title: The same standards we hold for the product.
principles.subtitle: We look for craft, judgment, and people who treat customer pain as a design problem.

items.title: Ship, then sharpen
items.body: We prefer a live path over a perfect deck. You will own work from sketch to production.

items.title: Write it down
items.body: Clear commits, clear copy, clear decisions. If it is not written, it is not finished.

items.title: Respect the room
items.body: Our users are mid-session. Design and engineering have to stay simple enough to use between clients.

roles.title: We're hiring.
roles.subtitle: Remote-friendly. If the work sounds like yours, join the list and tell us what you want to build.
roles.empty: No open roles right now. Join the list and we’ll write when a seat opens.

items.title: Frontend Developer
items.body: Build responsive, accessible booking interfaces using Vue.js and Nuxt. Focus on performance, clean component architecture, and seamless user experiences across devices.

items.title: Backend Developer
items.body: Design and ship scalable APIs for bookings, payments, and reminders. Work with databases, authentication, and integrations that handle real-world scheduling load.

items.title: DevOps Engineer
items.body: Maintain deployment pipelines, monitoring, and infrastructure. Keep the platform reliable, secure, and simple to operate from commit to production.

items.title: UI/UX Designer
items.body: Design intuitive booking flows from first click to confirmation. Create interfaces that work beautifully on mobile and desktop with minimal friction.

closing.title: Don't see the role?
closing.subtitle: Write anyway. We hire for craft and judgment, not a perfect title match.
